fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Start time (Unix seconds) of the query time range, inclusive.

fields.name: end_time
fields.description: End time (Unix seconds) of the query time range, exclusive.

fields.name: bucket_width
fields.description: Width of each time bucket in response. Currently only `1d` is supported, default to `1d`.

fields.name: project_ids
fields.description: Return only costs for these projects.

fields.name: api_key_ids
fields.description: Return only costs for these API keys.

fields.name: group_by
fields.description: Group the costs by the specified fields. Support fields include `project_id`, `line_item`, `api_key_id` and any combination of them.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of buckets to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 180, and the default is 7.

fields.name: page
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. Corresponding to the `next_page` field from the previous response.
